summary: Iteration 4 retest of the 2 HIGH items from iteration 3 plus the stale-session fix. All pass. (1) Login lands on /crm/consola, and visiting /crm/login while logged in redirects to /crm/consola. (2) In Consola ao Vivo, clicking take-btn-<id> stays on /crm/consola, keeps the device selected (lime border), and shows the 'Pedido atribuído a si' bar with console-accept-btn in the centre. Clicking accept starts the stream state on the console (status Em curso, 'A estabelecer a transmissão', commands enabled). The no-navigation-on-failure path was checked by code review only (`if (!ok) return`). (3) end_stale_sessions: pending and active sessions whose device has been offline for more than 10 minutes are ended with ended_by 'sistema (cliente desligado)' via GET /api/sessions and GET /api/dashboard. A device offline for 3 minutes is not ended. Regression passed: header counters (novos/ativas/online go 1/0/1 -> 0/1/1 -> 0/0/1), privacy on/off (the device received the events), guided message (the device received chat:message and the input cleared), and Terminar assistência.

minor.endpoint: socket emits to device (privacy:enabled, privacy:disabled, session:ended)
minor.issue: The simulated device received every privacy and session:ended event twice. The device socket is in both room session:<id> and room device:<id>, and end_session (realtime.py) emits to both rooms. Clients that are not idempotent may show duplicate toasts or overlays. Fix: emit once, with room=[...] and skip_sid, or dedupe.

issues: Sonner toasts (top-right) cover the header counters and the user/logout area for a few seconds after each action

action_items: Optional: stop sending duplicate socket events to devices that are in both the session room and the device room.
Optional: move the toasts away from the header counters (e.g. bottom-right).
critical_code_review_comments: end_stale_sessions runs on every GET /sessions and /dashboard. That is fine at the current scale, but it does a distinct plus a loop each time; consider throttling it like cleanup_retention.
The session ended by a technician stores ended_by as the user id, while the system end stores a readable label. This is inconsistent for display.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ devices and sessions were created and cleaned up (devices with an install_id starting TEST_ were deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stale test: pymongo directly sets devices.last_seen 11 minutes back and online false after the socket disconnects. Console flow without navigation: console-device-<sid> -> take-btn-<sid> -> console-accept-btn (same page). Privacy: console-privacy-btn, then console-privacy-off-btn / console-privacy-ask-btn. Guided message: console-msg-input + console-msg-send. End: console-end-btn. Sim device: `cd /app/backend/tests && python sim_android_device.py 400 > /tmp/sim_dev.log &`.
